title: P vs NP
subtitle: Unsolved problem
summary: Is every efficiently verifiable problem also efficiently solvable? Clay Millennium Prize.
detail:
The central open problem in theoretical computer science.

\[\text{Does }P=NP?\]

P: decidable in polynomial time. NP: verifiable in polynomial time. Most experts believe P≠NP, but no proof exists. A proof of P=NP would break most public-key cryptography.
